introduction: Follow the four serpent scales, two independent visage returns, Issis's petition, Vaprak's standard and Flant's books. Keep current materials, accepted returns and unfinished source or access leads distinct.
orientation: Follow six independent returns among the Spires: the Feathered Serpent, two mask makers, Issis, Horanth and Flant. Some native sources and routes need builder review; the journal describes the encoded exchanges without promising that every source is currently accessible.

The Feathered Serpent accepts four different scales together for an elder key. The Emerald Princess, Eshadow, Xaod and Dendar are the declared scale holders. Each exact scale has its own current count; collecting one scale does not substitute for the others.

Tix and the ordinary doppleganger each accept the visage of Dendar for a doppleganger mask. These are different giver receipts. One consumed visage cannot pay both makers; obtain another exact visage if you want both returns.

Ask Issis loss about her petition. She accepts the hide of Kezef for a skull key. The current native files declare the hound but do not configure a source for this exact hide. Her revenge against Slaazh remains a separate lead, not another encoded completion.

Ask Horanth outrage about the stolen standard. The standard of Vaprak is declared in a hidden vault. Its accepted return yields horns of Vaprak. The request to kill every lizard in the temple does not create a tracked kill count.

Flant accepts three different books together for his arquebuse. The books are declared on a dining table, in the hidden vault and in the library. His captivity and weapon plans do not encode a separate rescue or weapon-use quest.

Required books, scales, visage and hide lack normal pickup flags. Direct floor or floor-corpse recovery may be refused. Recovering an item from your own carried container can behave differently; a supplied exact item also fits the native return. Current custody does not prove how you obtained it.

Prepare every requested item loose in your inventory before offering a matching item. A four-scale or three-book return consumes its full exact set. Worn, held, nested or spent items do not fill current preparation counts; an accepted receipt remains recorded after the inputs are gone.

The naga switch is declared in the gauntlet and targets the east wall at the naga sigil. The shadow switch is declared at the shadow rune and targets the west wall at the shadow sigil. PULL the visible matching switch, then SEARCH the unblocked secret passage and cross it when admitted.

A switch opens only its configured near-side blockage. In particular the naga passage can remain blocked from the reverse side. Arrival, a reset and return travel are separate from pressing words or merely seeing a switch.

The Witch King carries an emerald key for the locked emerald approach. Issis rewards the skull key for Slaazh's door. The Feathered Serpent rewards the elder key for the elder gate. Emerald and elder keys break after a successful unlock; keep usable keys loose or held.

The current registered room graph has no outside entrance or incoming object portal. Even assuming arrival in the foyer, selected keys and switches do not connect every section. Dendar and Kezef occupy a separate section. Builders must qualify an intended arrival and source route before these leads promise a complete trip.

The Elf-Eater, summoning circle, sacrifices, captive emissaries and nightmare scenes supply story context. No selected rescue, conversion, sun-restoration, hide-carving or summoning terminal is encoded. A monster name, item description or spoken topic alone is not an achievement.

Declared reset locations are leads, not guaranteed stock. Current active accounting declines native reset item issuance. Daily rollover does not create materials, reconnect rooms or settle rewards. New discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily progress requires active, ready accounting.
